property_summary: For every input, when assertionDisputedCallback is called by the optimistic asserter, the contract must NOT emit a PriceRequestAdded event (i.e., requestPrice should not be callable by arbitrary addresses), but the mutant that removed the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier allows external callers to cause PriceRequestAdded to be emitted and thus diverges for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from requestPrice so it can be called by any address, changing whether the PriceRequestAdded event (and thus observable state via event logs) is emitted after calls.
